title: Мини-Проект: "Мой Трудный День" (Продукт)
description: Напиши 5 предложений о том, что ты делал долго, и какой у тебя результат сейчас.
topic: Напиши 5 предложений о том, что ты делал долго, и какой у тебя результат сейчас

conditions.label: Present Perfect Continuous (have/has been + V-ing)
conditions.hint: I have been doing homework for 3 hours.

examples: I have been learning English for six years, and now I have reached B1 level.
I have been playing the guitar since I was ten, so now I have learned to play many songs.
I have been training at the gym for two years, and now I have become much stronger.
I have been reading this book for three days, and now I have finished half of it.
I have been saving money since January, so now I have bought a new phone.
